prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop landing-page decision comp, first viewport only, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design the conventional ‘Polished product landing page’ option for Orifude, a keyboard-only terminal application for exchanging one private letter and one optional reply with an unrelated stranger. It should look production-ready, editorial, quiet, and exceptionally restrained rather than experimental.
Input images: Image 1 is the official transparent Orifude wordmark and must be used unchanged in the header; Image 2 is the real shipped terminal recording poster and must be placed unchanged as the dominant product proof; Image 3 is the official squirrel courier cutout and must be preserved unchanged, used once as a small meaningful delivery accent beside the terminal proof.
Scene/backdrop: warm washi page ground in #fbf7f1 with extremely subtle paper texture, not a staged physical mockup.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 desktop web viewport. Slim generous header with official wordmark left and three plain text links right. Below, a clean asymmetric two-column hero: left column contains the headline, supporting paragraph, plain download action, secondary repository link, and a concise private-alpha note; right column contains one large unrounded terminal proof using Image 2, with the courier subtly perched at its lower edge. Strong alignment, abundant breathing room, no content below the fold except a restrained hint of the next section. The page must read immediately as a downloadable terminal product, not a browser letter-writing app.
Style/medium: shippable high-fidelity website screenshot. Conventional premium product landing-page craft with a literary editorial voice. Alegreya-like warm serif for the headline and humanist sans-serif for factual copy. Monospace only inside the supplied terminal image.
Lighting/mood: calm daylight warmth, crisp interface rendering, understated confidence.
Color palette: background #fbf7f1, text #292823, primary action and restrained accents #626851, terminal near-black from Image 2. No other dominant colors.
Text (verbatim): Headline: ‘Send a letter into the quiet.’ Supporting copy: ‘Orifude carries one private letter to one unrelated stranger, who may send one reply. The exchange lives entirely in your terminal.’ Primary action: ‘Download v0.2.0’ Secondary action: ‘View on GitHub’ Header links: ‘How it works’ ‘Privacy’ ‘Download’ Status note: ‘Private alpha · Invite-only online access’ Terminal caption: ‘A real letter, carried once’
Constraints: Preserve the official wordmark, terminal poster, and courier artwork faithfully. Keep all text horizontal and readable. The download action is a simple solid moss rectangular button with subtly clipped paper-tab corners, not a pill. Use a single fine horizontal rule in the header and minimal paper-fold detail only where it supports the brand. No invented metrics, testimonials, customer logos, service claims, app screens, dashboards, or browser message composer.
Avoid: glows, gradients, glassmorphism, border soup, rounded-card grids, excessive rounded rectangles, generic SaaS card layouts, dashboard UI, excessive monospace, tiny uppercase labels, eyebrows or kickers, oversized empty headline typography, decorative Japanese motifs, neon, blue or purple accents, fake terminal content, duplicated courier, watermarks, device mockups.
postprocess: Centered vertical crop from the generated 1536x1024 frame to the requested 1536x960 16:10 viewport, then lossless WebP conversion.
